rationale: Describes conventional multi-cloud management: catalog-based environment fulfillment, master orchestration, release orchestration for DevOps, and cloud governance. The word adaptive is not described as learned or AI-driven.
evidence_spans: HCM flexibly automates the dynamic fulfillment of a wide range of environments from a streamlined catalog, using adaptive service designs and a master orchestrator
HCM features integrated application release orchestration for DevOps and cloud governance
